A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The attacker spends 239 dollars and 16 days per identity before it can vote at all.
